severity_name: HEAVY SLOP WARNING — COORDINATED PERSONA ADVISORY
headline: HEAVY SLOP WARNING: SYNTHETIC-PERSONA FRONT SPREADS ACROSS THE X BADLANDS AS MASS-PRODUCED ACCOUNTS PUSH LOW-GRADE INFLUENCE DEBRIS AND PHANTOM EVENT LISTINGS DIRECT RESIDENTS TOWARD GATHERINGS THAT WERE NEVER SCHEDULED
advisory: A broad system of coordinated synthetic accounts is moving through the X Badlands and adjacent basins, generating high volumes of low-effort imagery, translated talking points, and identical opinions held by thousands of profiles created the same afternoon. The Service notes the material is voluminous but poorly assembled; residents may observe six-fingered spokespersons and captions translated through three languages back into a fourth. A secondary hazard has developed downwind, where automated event listings are directing residents toward festivals, parades, and grand openings that do not exist. Do not put on a costume until the parade is confirmed by a human with a phone number.

regional_outlook.conditions: Dense persona fog with reduced visibility. Thousands of accounts reporting identical weather in identical wording; treat all consensus as unverified until a human is located.
Steady drizzle of machine-written articles holding at roughly half of new precipitation. Human-authored ground remains, but it is increasingly hard to see through the mist.
Rising tide of personalized outreach that knows your first name and nothing else. Salutations arriving pre-generated; expect flooding around the greeting line.
Scattered five-star reviews falling on apps that have not yet launched. Enthusiasm forecast to exceed functionality throughout the day.
Light accumulation of 40-page 'complete guides' generated overnight. Table of contents present; contents largely not.

specimen.status: Locally abundant; migrates to whichever town has a photogenic main street.
specimen.habitat: Auto-generated event calendars, algorithmic 'things to do near you' feeds, and glossy listing pages with no organizer and no cancellation policy.
specimen.field_marks: A radiant hero image of a parade, fireworks, or lantern release rendered in impossible golden light. Look for a venue that resolves to an empty parking lot, a 'starts at dusk' with no date, and a ticket link that leads only to a longer ticket link.
specimen.call: Join thousands this weekend for the Annual Harbor Lights Spectacular — a beloved local tradition returning for its first year!
specimen.confusion_species: Easily mistaken for a genuine community event listing. Distinguish by the human details: a real festival has a phone number that a tired volunteer actually answers, a parking complaint from last year, and at least one photo where the weather is disappointing.

spotter_tip: Before you drive downtown in a costume, try to find one ordinary person who is annoyed about the parking. Real gatherings generate logistics; phantom ones generate only beautiful pictures.
tomorrow: Persona fog thinning by midday, but phantom event listings expected to intensify ahead of the weekend — verify before you commute.

confirmed_sighting.report: Social media analytics firm Graphika reports that major state-sponsored influence operations, including ones tied to China and Russia, have increasingly adopted generative AI to mass-produce low-quality images, video, text, and translations — though researchers note the output is frequently executed poorly. The Service confirms: the propaganda is now automated, and it still cannot spell.
